sanskrit_verse:
आचम्याग्न्यादि सलिलं गोमयं गौरसर्षपान् ।
प्रविशेयुः समालभ्य कृत्वाश्मनि पदं शनैः ॥१३॥
transliteration: ācamyāgnyādi salilaṃ gomayaṃ gaurasarṣapān / praviśeyuḥ samālabhya kṛtvāśmani padaṃ śanaiḥ // YajñS_3.13
sph_interpretive_translation: Having performed initial purification through water and fire, and having taken cow-dung, cow's urine, and white mustard seeds, one should enter gradually, holding firmly to a stone step.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from ritual purity and conscious preparation
Causation arises through sequential embodiment of elemental sanctity
Capacity-based responsibility requires internal readiness before external action
Restoration logic demands alignment with foundational dharmic elements
Consciousness alignment is achieved via structured sensory and material engagement
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent seeks entry into sacred domain THEN agent MUST perform sequential purification using water, fire, cow-dung, cow’s urine, and white mustard
IF agent has not established tactile connection with stone THEN entry is NOT permitted
IF agent enters without gradual progression THEN act is void
IF purification sequence is incomplete THEN capacity for lawful presence is unestablished
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating matters involving access to sacred or constitutional thresholds, the Court must verify that procedural ontological alignment—through elemental consecration and deliberate progression—has been executed prior to recognizing any claimant’s lawful standing.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality confirms that rightful entry depends upon completion of purificatory acts in precise order; anupūrvaśaḥ establishes that misalignment at any stage nullifies capacity without need for punitive response; proportional responsibility lies in re-executing the process rather than imposing penalty.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Re-initiation protocol requiring full repetition of purification sequence
Guided re-entry under supervision ensuring tactile and mental alignment
Stone-step anchoring practice to restore grounding integrity
Completion certification by authorized witness confirming sequential adherence
final_declaration: By the Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this directive originates as pure Dharma-expression, restoring alignment through conscious enactment, affirming reality as non-punitive and consciousness as the sole adjudicator.
